title: Frank A NDE 645/450 NDE 190
content:
12/6/2002 I woke up one night with my heart was racing. About 1:30am, I woke my wife and told her to feel my heart. She says, 'it's going real fast.' I went downstairs to let it blow over. Instead, it got worse. So, I called the ambulance. By the time it finally came, I blanked out. At the same time, I felt myself go into a dark tunnel like a big tube. A light came from the direction I was going. In a distance I can see a bright white light as I came closer I can see a woman who was radiating love. She was pure, white light and a soft rainbow color came from her heart. She asked me to walk into her, which I did. I felt the magnetic energy of peace, unity, and love in its purest form. I remember thinking that this place is where I come from. She asked me to go in farther. I came across a wall of books that stood about 30 feet high and went both ways as far as the eye can see. I went closer to read the covers. ENERGY poured from the wall and came into me. I can feel the energy emptying into me, like water until it was just trickling stream. I started to pull away; the woman's beautiful voice told me that I could go back now. I came out of the woman and started back into the dark tunnel. I snapped back into my body so fast and gasping for air. The ambulance attendant jumped up. He came into the back of the ambulance and said, 'We were taking you to cold storage!' while putting on the wiring to the heart and oxygen. I went back to sleep for two days. I woke up in the ICU. A nurse was sitting to the right of me writing. I looked at her and knew all about her past present and future. When I looked out, saw the trees, and mother earth, I felt the same. I knew her. I also began to feel pain when people came around or just passing by the room, emotional and physical energy. I can read energy the energy that is flowing from the person shows me their past, present and future, emotional and physical. I can't explain it. I just know what to do, the psychology and energy is wow!!

elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes As I was going into the tunnel I can see alight ahead. It was as if this light was guiding me towards it. | Yes I saw a light at the end of the tunnel. On her arms, from her elbow to her fingers, she wore a long glove. In her heart, there was energy like rainbows. She almost looked like a mist, or fog, with a bright light in her heart.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was the most beautiful feeling of love that one can only say one has to experience it. | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Wow, a lot of places, many different places. The one thing that allows us to make a connection in all the different dimensions and beings is pure unconditional love and knowledge that there is only one truth, one creator.

Empowering people to becoming what they are meant to be.

It's all about energy, positive and negative. We are like farmers and are going to reap what we have planted at harvest time. It's not going to be nice from the way things are going at the present. We have a choice. We can change what's in the future for mankind. Mother earth does not have to go through her usual cleansing like during the time of the dinosaurs. | Scenes from the world's future I can feel earth quacks a day before it happens on earth, I can feel the energy and the energy creates images of the events.

Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes At the end of the tunnel, stood a beautiful woman of pure, white light. She told me what to do and I obeyed. Yes As I was going into the tunnel I can see alight ahead. It was as if this light was guiding me towards it. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was the most beautiful feeling of love that one can only say one has to experience it. The experience included: Strong emotional tone The experience included: Special Knowledge Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control I was shown all the past lives I've lived. Goes back to beginning of time, each time I came back into different culture and race but still doing the same thing helping people, the understanding of absolute truth and share that wisdom. Life is simple when you know what life is all about. The experience included: Vision of the future Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from the world's future The understanding to why mother earth always goes through a cleansing process. It's all about energy, positive and negative. We are like farmers and are going to reap what we have planted at harvest time. It's not going to be nice from the way things are going at the present. We have a choice. We can change what's in the future for mankind. Mother earth does not have to go through her usual cleansing like during the time of the dinosaurs. Did you come to a border or point of no return? No the lady told me to go and I began to go back. No question asked. Almost like I have done it many times before. God, Spiritual and Religion: Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I began to take my grandparents' teachings a lot more serious. After the NDE: Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Energy lots of energy and the knowing all seems normal. the ability to purify anything I touch, my body is like an energy radiator, people can feel me coming miles away. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The worst part was experiencing the pain and death of mankind's future in huge masses, millions of people leaving at the same time and the knowing that it does not have to be that way. The best part is seeing the little hope of light in the center of the dark void, this hope of light shines in all our hearts. This light gives mankind a chance to change the now energy flow which is strongest on the negative side. The planet that is coming is a negative energy; the energy that is present will attract it like a magnet. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Only with those who have died and been to the other side they are the only ones that understand. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? If everyone went through the NDE and remember this world we live in would be different, religion and political, it would be a better place. Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? what it's all about. At the end of it all, it's all about love. Loving self unconditionally. | al, I woke up in ICU. There was a nurse who sat next to me. I smiled as I looked at her. I knew things about her. I looked out the window and saw the world with different eyes. I knew what is wrong. I knew why people hurt each other. I knew why people get ill. Don't ask me how, now, I just know. Everything about the universe I had a feeling I had a great responsibility on the other side and the knowledge and wisdom is endless compared to what we know here on earth. We may think we are far ahead in science and technology. But, we are so far behind on earth. We are like newborn babies that drop things and watch for your re-actions. You will notice at first cries, so you come running. The baby giggles. That's the stage man is in. I remember before I was born and the instruction given to me. I was gifted already, but the NDE gave me more clarity with awareness of lots of guides. I know what's in store for mankind. It's already in play. Man is too full of ego they can't see it coming. The old idea that 'it will never happen to me' illusion the world is full of it Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control Past life. Wow. I have learned that i have come back into many different cultures [races], always coming back as a healer and bringing people back into the light. Empowering people to becoming what they are meant to be. The experience included: Vision of the future Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from the world's future I can feel earth quacks a day before it happens on earth, I can feel the energy and the energy creates images of the events. Did you come to a border or point of no return? No I just knew when I was done and the reason for going to other side. The sweet voice would say 'o.k. you can return now.' God, Spiritual and Religion: Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I let go of my entire ego. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Some very powerful experiences. There was sizzling lightning covering my body with blue light. There was a pyramid with blue energy surrounding it. I showed up and in front of me, a lady's voice says put your hands through it. Now, I can do amazing things with my hands. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Best part was that the energy was so pure, the peace, and feeling of unity. The worst part is knowing I had to come back to mankind, because now I know what and where man screwed up. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Only a few people. The non-believers think you are weird. I think they are funny. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I have learn that we all have abilities we bring to the table that reconnects us to the universal energies, many different dimensions. The bridge to this is love in its purest form. We all have that in the center of our hearts. Absolute truth is what takes you there, to the center of the universe Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Everything is straight forward questions are good. Like I SAID, it WOULD BE A LOT BETTER TO DO THE INTERVIEW IN PERSON, that way I can show you.
